title: WHAT EXISTS names the parent of an absent file
intention: WHAT EXISTS names the existing directory an absent cited file would be written into, so the rehearsal's reader never concludes a present directory is missing.
why: Measured 2026-10-29 on 284798998ab0 rehearsal pass 3 (CairnCommons/rehearsals/284798998ab0-20261029T203646.json): the plan cites cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_ticket_is_three_files.py, a file the build creates; WHAT EXISTS listed it absent and named no cairn/tools/base/proofs/ entry, and read 1 stopped D9, D10 and D11 on 'WHAT EXISTS lists only cairn/tools/base/probes/'. The directory exists. Akien 2026-10-29: "we should be telling it what exists and what doesn't before hand".
traces_to: c9897770efe6 (the rehearsal is a build simulator, handed what exists); Law 3 (the reader is handed measurements, so an unmeasured directory reads as a claim of absence)
how: In cairn/machines/rehearsal/rehearsal.py what_exists, after the bases loop, for each absent relative path entry whose parent directory exists (at a root, or under a base), append {kind: 'path', name: '<parent spelled as cited>/', found: True} unless that name is already listed. A tooth in cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_the_rehearsal_is_a_build_simulator.py covers it.
falsifier: Done when what_exists over a plan citing an absent file in a present directory lists that directory as a present path, and an absent file in an absent directory adds no entry; wrong intent if the next rehearsal of 284798998ab0 still stops on cairn/tools/base/proofs/ as missing while the list names it present.
watchme: none, because the horizon is read directly at the next rehearsal of 284798998ab0 (its record lands under CairnCommons/rehearsals/), a ticket already in flight

decisions.text: D1: In cairn/machines/rehearsal/rehearsal.py, what_exists gains one pass after its bases loop (the `while grew:` loop) and before `return out`: for each entry e with kind 'path', found False, a relative name (not absolute after expanduser) and a parent P = Path(e['name']).parent that is not '' or '.', if P is a directory at any root (root / P) or under any base (d / P for each (d, spell) in bases), append {'kind': 'path', 'name': str(P) + '/', 'found': True} — plus 'at': f'{spell}/{P}' when it was found under a base rather than at a root — unless str(P) + '/' or str(P) is already a name in out. The new entries go after every existing entry, in first-seen order of their files.

D2: _what_exists_lines needs no change: an entry {'kind': 'path', 'name': 'x/', 'found': True} already prints as 'present path x/'. The docstring of what_exists gains one sentence saying an absent file's present parent directory rides as its own present entry.

D3: cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_the_rehearsal_is_a_build_simulator.py gains a tooth test_what_exists_names_the_present_parent_of_an_absent_file, in the style of the two what_exists teeth there (scratch_dir, a fixture repo): a repo holding cairn/tools/t/proofs/ (with one file in it) and no gone/ dir; texts citing cairn/tools/t/proofs/new_proof.py, cairn/tools/t/proofs/other.py and gone/x.py; it asserts new_proof.py and other.py and gone/x.py read found False, cairn/tools/t/proofs/ reads found True and appears exactly once, and no entry named gone/ or gone exists. The tooth is red before D1 and green after. The existing teeth's `len(got) == 5` assert in test_what_exists_measures_paths_and_modules_without_importing is updated to the new count only if D1 adds an entry there (drafts/ does not exist there, so it should not).

D4: PROVES in that proof file stays {'c9897770efe6': {'all': 'test_the_rehearsal_is_a_build_simulator'}} and gains '5e71da822b3d': {'all': 'test_what_exists_names_the_present_parent_of_an_absent_file'}; the composite tooth test_the_rehearsal_is_a_build_simulator already runs every test_ tooth, so it runs the new one too.
